patient.notes: EGFR exon 19 deletion. Took osimertinib for 14 months, then the cancer grew. No brain metastases on my last MRI. I can walk and do light housework but not heavy work. Type 2 diabetes, controlled with metformin. Never had any other cancer. Not pregnant.
